item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description: Spam Filter Free Day, short update: I spent a total of 2 hours deleting 1111 spam comments, re-activating Akismet etc., and re-finding the 6 valid comments and trackbacks recieved during the last 24 hours. More info in separate post later.

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
We have recieved a total of 1317 spam comments the last nine days … roughly 146 each day on average. So the spam count is a little up … but not that much.

115 the last 24 hours.

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Still, the number keeps low: Now 229 spam comments in the last 60 hours — only 3 spam comments per hour on average — or 72 per day.

And only 229-127 = 102 spam comments since I published this post yesterday, 30.6 hours ago.

I really wonder what’s going on?

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description: After Thomas added the Akismet counter to the frontpage anyone can follow our spam count publically. Currently 513,000 (which is roughly 12,000 in the last 7 days including the last day with only 127 spam comments)
